notes.title: Glow-in-the-dark plastic Skulls hot out of the mold-o-matic!
notes.content:
Both the main experience and the miniature railway level now each have 40 glow-in-the-dark plastic skull souvenirs hidden throughout. Can you find and destroy them all?

notes.title: New Bonus Level "Miniature Railway"
notes.content:
Just outside the main entrance of Ghost Town Mine Ride, near the parking lot, is the "other" train ride at Black Rock Mines, The "Children's Storybook Mine Train".You know,... for kids! The marketing for the attraction once described it as "A scenic excursion through beloved children's tales, set in the beautiful forest of Black Rock Hills." I'm not sure how you'd describe it now, but you can ride this short seated experience yourself by shooting at the "miniature railway" board in the main menu area.
Also, For those that want more of a challenge, you can now choose "Hardcore" mode in the main menu area. With this option enabled you only have one chance to make it out alive! 
This update also has some more optimization and bug fixes. 
Thank you all for your support!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26553415/2a6b966a2e840f5af80145ae06f833d2f4fd44a4.png[/img]

notes.title: New Oculus Update
notes.content:
The latest update moves the oculus/vive adjustment from the keyboard  into the main menu, and also adds the ability to swap left/right controllers. 
Simply touch the signs in the main menu area to use. Enjoy!

notes.title: Oculus Rift and Touch controllers now supported!
notes.content: Ghost Town Mine Ride now supports both Vive and Oculus Rift with touch controllers! To adjust for Oculus touch controllers, press "t" on your keyboard. (We're looking into streamlining this process in a future update.) This update also has been optimized more to fix some of the "flashing to Vive world" problems. Happy Holidays!

notes.title: No Oculus Rift Support
notes.content: Just  a reminder that this experience is currently only playable on the Vive and does not yet support the Oculus Rift as is listed on the store page. We will be adding support for the Rift sometime soon.

notes.title: First Update now available!
notes.content:
This update should fix the problem of falling out of the mine cart.
Pressing the space bar on your keyboard now pauses and un-pauses the experience. Shooting the "Mine Ride" level selection board in the main menu room now starts you in the first mine cart ride. We are still looking into the "flashing to Vive world" issues and hope to resolve that in a later update. 
Thank You all for your incredible show of support! We are thrilled you like it because we plan on bringing you more VR experiences in the future!

notes.title: Happy Halloween
notes.content: Thanks everyone for an awesome first day release! We really appreciate all the great reviews! We are looking into fixing some of the bugs that have shown up, such as falling through the map, or "flashes to Vive world", with an update asap. Have a safe and enjoyable Halloween!
